question.problem:
Which of the following scatter plots shows a possible exponential dependence between the variables?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226611/assets/33343af118a165da06ca7e361088bad26a7ced2b0039179822fe046d9ffd761b.png)
question.worked_solution:
In the case of exponential dependence, the points on the plot should be scattered along a curve whose $y$-values increase or decrease rapidly.

Among the given options, the only scatter plot that fits the description is the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226611/assets/fc96819983d673d889cbf8be48e92f4546010640d555d1b41074fd031cf4430d.png)
